page.overview:
Who is Colonel Steve Austin?

Colonel Steve Austin is the primary protagonist of Martin Caidin's Cyborg series of novels and the television series spinoff of these books, The Six Million Dollar Man. After a almost-deadly military plane crash, as the result of a classified government project, Steve Austin was reconstructed into the world's first bionic man.

Steve Austin is a secret agent who works for Oscar Goldman at OSI, the Office of Scientific Intelligence, where his speed, strength and other Bionic attributes, help him achieve the goals on his various missions.

Steve Austin appears in the G.I. Joe vs. The Six Million Dollar Man comics from IDW/Dynamite.

Steve Austin also appears in The Six Million Dollar Man and some Bionic Woman comics from both Dymanite and Charlton. Category:Characters
